title: Equipment entry (base fields, common to every category)
description: Category is not a field in the file - it's implied by which folder under data/<root>/... the file lives in, mirroring data/categories.json.

id.description: Unique, immutable ID. Format: manufacturer-model-slug, e.g. arri-alexa-mini-lf

image_url.description: Only link to freely licensed images (e.g. Wikimedia Commons), no uploads of your own into the repo

source_url.description: Link to manufacturer page/datasheet for verification
